```{julia}
using DrWatson
@quickactivate "project"
using DataFrames, Plots, CSV

df = CSV.read(datadir("beta_scan_all.csv"), DataFrame)

p1 = plot(df.beta, df.peak, label = "Пик", xlabel = "beta", ylabel = "Доля инфицированных")
plot!(p1, df.beta, df.final_inf, label = "Конечная")

p2 = plot(df.beta, df.deaths, xlabel = "beta", ylabel = "Число умерших", legend = false)

p3 = plot(df.beta, df.final_rec, xlabel = "beta", ylabel = "Доля выздоровевших", legend = false)

plot(p1, p2, p3, layout = (3, 1), size = (800, 900))

mkpath(plotsdir())
savefig(plotsdir("comprehensive_analysis.png"))

println("Готово! Сводный график сохранён.")
```
